show.description: Sushant Singh narrates a chilling crime story where a seemingly perfect family hides dangerous secrets, betrayal, and obsession. When a husband returns home after sensing something is terribly wrong, a horrifying mystery begins to unfold. A red drum sealed with cement, missing family members, hidden affairs, and shocking lies lead police into one of the most disturbing murder investigations imaginable. But who is the real monster behind it all?
